text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa made a debut that truly 
showed off her immense talent.

And from her mouth came a shocking 
declaration: "Skip the Classic Triple 
Crown and aim to conquer the Japan Cup as 
a Classic-class Umamusume."

Because what El Condor Pasa aims to be 
isn't the "strongest of her generation," 
but the "strongest in the world." She had 
decided to forge a path different from her 
best friends'.

To assess her aptitude, her next target 
race was set for the Kyodo News Hai, held 
at an appropriate time and distance in the 
new year.
